definition: a disease that emaciates the body.
example_en: The wasting disease emaciated his body.

definition: the blossom of a plant; a flower.
example_en: That creeper's flower was red in color.

definition: the quality of being black; blackness.
example: ಅವಳ ಕೂದಲಿನ ಮೇಚಕತೆ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಕಣ್ಣು ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The blackness of her hair caught everyone's eye.

definition: a man with the nose chopped off; a disgraced man.
example_en: The villagers laugh when they see the man with the chopped-off nose.

definition: the region in South Asia, south of the Himalayas, including a large peninsula between the Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal, stretching into the Indian Ocean, that became independent in 1947 and a republic nation in 1950; India (more popularly known as Bhārata).
example_en: India became independent in 1947.

definition: a man who takes care of or protects; a care-taker.
example_en: The caretaker guarded the house throughout the night.

definition: to give a general rather than a specific or special character or form to; to generalise.
example_en: The teacher explained the lesson by generalising it.

definition: a kind of plant.
example_en: The nēri plant grows on the bank of the pond.

definition: a deadly poison.
example: ಶಿವನು ಕಾಳಕೂಟ ವಿಷವನ್ನು ಕುಡಿದನೆಂದು ಪುರಾಣ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The Purana says that Shiva drank the deadly poison.

definition: a man who mocks; a mocker.
example_en: That mocker used to mock everyone.

definition: to chop into small pieces.
example_en: The cook chopped the onion into small pieces with a knife.

definition: a fleeing from or leaving one's country, esp. permanently; a self-imposed exile.
example_en: People fled their country out of fear of war.

definition: the time in the morning when daylight first appears; dawn.
example_en: As dawn broke, the birds began to sing.

definition: a mountain.
example_en: The peak of that mountain was hidden in the clouds.

definition: a dark room or underground cell, vault or prison; a dungeon.
example_en: The prisoner was confined in the dark dungeon.

definition: the inner surface of anything.
example_en: The inner surface of that vessel is very smooth.

definition: the uncomfortable or distressful feeling caused by a desire or need for water and characterised generally by a sensation of dryness in the mouth and throat; thirst.
example_en: Walking in the hot sun, he felt thirsty.

definition: a heart trembling from fear or anxiety.
example_en: Out of fear, her trembling heart beat loudly.

definition: any of various large grass hoppers, having short antennae, destroys vegetation while traveling in great swarms often; a locust.
example: ಮಿಡಚೆಗಳ ಗುಂಪು ಬಂದು ಹೊಲದ ಬೆಳೆಯನ್ನು ನಾಶಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: A swarm of locusts came and destroyed the crop in the field.

definition: a patient who lives in hospital while under treatment; an in-patient.
example_en: They gave special care to the in-patient in the hospital.

definition: to include, contain (without oneself, one's sphere, range, jurisdiction, etc.).
example_en: This agreement includes all the departments.

definition: a clawlike deformity of a toe, usu. the second; hammer-toe.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಅವಳ ಕೊಡತಿಬೆಟ್ಟುಗೆ ಶಸ್ತ್ರಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆ ಸಲಹೆ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor suggested surgery for her hammer-toe.

definition: a strong, metal or wooden box.
example_en: The merchant kept the money securely in the strong box.

definition: a perplexed, confounded man.
example: ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಕೇಳಿ ಆ ಅಪ್ರತಿಭ ಮೌನವಾಗಿ ನಿಂತನು.
example_en: Hearing the question, that perplexed man stood silently.

definition: (myth.) Rāhu, one of the nine astrological planets, which rule the destination of all beings (as the one that is believed to hold the sun and moon).
example_en: The astrologer explained the influence of Rahu, the sky-wandering serpent.

definition: the fragrance of incense.
example_en: The fragrance of incense had spread throughout the temple.

definition: to beat to pulp; to pound; to pulverise.
example_en: The cook pounded the garlic into a pulp to make a paste.

definition: (sarc.) a loud speaker.
example_en: That loud speaker made noise the whole night.

definition: a woman who habitually lies; a lier.
example_en: Nobody believes the words of that lying woman.

definition: amounting to forty in number.
example_en: There were forty mangoes in that bag.

definition: the state or time of being a woman; womanhood.
example_en: She upheld her womanhood with dignity.

definition: a rope used to tie with.
example_en: He tied the rope to the bullocks.

definition: the act or an instance of beating.
example_en: The child began to cry from his beating.

definition: speedily; swiftly.
example_en: The boy ran off swiftly.

definition: to be affected by a rust fungus; to rust.
example_en: In the rainy season, the iron gate rusts quickly.

definition: a man who cheats in playing dice.
example_en: The dice cheat deceived everyone and won.

definition: delighted; glad; pleased.
example_en: On hearing the result, he became delighted.

definition: the rear portion.
example_en: Supplies were kept at the rear of the army.

definition: a ripe fruit.
example_en: There were ripe fruits in the basket.

definition: (physically) undergone penance or austere life.
example: ಆ ಋಷಿ ತಪಃಕ್ಲಾಂತನಾಗಿ ಮರದ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಕುಳಿತ.
example_en: That sage, physically worn out from penance, sat beneath the tree.

definition: a minor folklore-god;
example_en: The villagers worship the minor folklore-god Adavijattinga.

definition: the division of an army that moves at the rear.
example: ಪ್ರತ್ಯಾಸಾರ ಸೈನ್ಯವು ಮುಖ್ಯ ಪಡೆಯ ಹಿಂದೆ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The rear division of the army marched behind the main force.

definition: one's entire properties.
example_en: He distributed his entire properties to his children.

definition: black colour.
example_en: His complexion had a black colour.

definition: to hold something as a reason or purpose for doing or not doing something.
example: ಅವನು ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ಬಾರದೆ ಇರಲು ಜ್ವರವನ್ನು ನೆವವಿಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: He gave fever as an excuse for not coming to work.

definition: strongly built or strong in substance; robust: sturdy; muscular; burly.
example_en: That young man has a robust body.

definition: to be installed in a firm position, place, etc.; to be established.
example_en: The new government became firmly established.

definition: a region that is not mountainous, but is almost level; the plains; open counry.
example_en: The wind blows without obstruction in the open plains.

definition: a man who protects, tends cattle; a cowherd.
example: ಆ ಗೋವ ದಿನವೂ ಹಸುಗಳನ್ನು ಕಾಡಿಗೆ ಕರೆದೊಯ್ಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That cowherd used to take the cows to the forest every day.

definition: the sun.
example_en: As soon as the sun set, the sky turned red.

definition: unable to be avoided, evaded or escaped; inevitable; inescapable.
example_en: Old age is inescapable for everyone.

definition: a king.
example_en: The king delivered judgment in the assembly.

definition: a being associated with; association.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಆ ತಂಡದ ಜೊತೆ ನಿಷಂಗ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: He had an association with that team.

definition: the act of contending; a strife, struggle, controversy, dispute, quarrel, etc.; a contention.
example_en: A dispute grew between the two groups.

definition: a kind of dish made of wheet flour.
example_en: Mother made poli, a dish of wheat flour, for us.

definition: a worthless man.
example: ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಅವನನ್ನು ಕಿಟ್ಟಕೀಳ ಎಂದು ದೂರ ಇಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: Everyone kept away from him calling him a worthless man.

definition: the state of (grains) being half-ground.
example_en: Because the mill stopped, the grain remained only half-ground.

definition: the plant Ocimum basilicum of Lamiaceae family; sweet basil.
example: ಅಡುಗೆಮನೆಯ ಕಿಟಕಿಯ ಬಳಿ ಕಾಮಕಸ್ತೂರಿ ಗಿಡ ಬೆಳೆಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: They have grown a sweet basil plant near the kitchen window.

definition: an inflammation of the nasal membrane; purulent deflection in the nose.
example_en: He was troubled by nasal inflammation in winter.

definition: a betel-leaf seller.
example_en: The betel-leaf seller was selling betel leaves in his shop.

definition: (pl.) excess work.
example_en: I have a lot of excess work this week.

definition: the plant Pisum arvense of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The farmers nurtured the field-pea crop well.

definition: to advise; to give a wise counsel.
example_en: The teacher advised the students on the good path.

definition: a very slender waist.
example_en: That doll's very slender waist was extremely thin.

definition: to become numbed physically; to be benumbed.
example_en: His fingers became numb from the cold.

definition: new; fresh.
example_en: He presented new ideas.

definition: a man who treats sick and injured persons; a doctor; a physician.
example_en: The physician examined the child who had a fever.

definition: confined; bound; tied.
example_en: That prisoner was bound with a chain.

definition: a plane figure with eight angles and eight sides; an octagon.
example_en: He drew the shape of an octagon in the picture.

definition: any of several families of Old and New World primates usu. having a flat, hairless face and a long tail; a monkey.
example_en: A monkey was sitting on the tree.

definition: a turning point where different roads intersect.
example_en: The bus turned left at the road junction.

definition: to gleam or shine in flashes; to glitter or glisten; to be brilliant; to sparkle.
example_en: Lightning glittered in the sky.

definition: (pl.) the hands and legs.
example_en: After falling, his hands and legs were aching.

definition: a meeting in opposition; an encountering.
example_en: The encounter of the two armies took place on the plain.

definition: (wooden structures etc.) to be eaten and destroyed by termites.
example_en: Because of the rain the wooden roof of the house was eaten and destroyed by termites.

definition: a membranous, pear-shaped sac closely connected by various ducts to the liver, in which excess gall or bile, is stored and concentrated; the gall-bladder.
example_en: The doctor performed surgery on the gall-bladder.

definition: to drive or force back; to prevent from coming near.
example_en: The police drove back the crowd and pushed it away.

definition: the shrub or small tree Morinda citrifolia of Rubiaceae family.
example_en: A morinda tree had grown in the corner of the yard.

definition: of different kinds, varieties, types, etc.
example_en: This garden has various kinds of flowers.

definition: originated, made or produced long back.
example_en: That fort is a construction from an old period.

definition: a writ calling upon one to show by what warrant he hold or claims a franchise or an office.
example_en: The court issued a writ against the official's authority.

definition: he who leads, guides others; a leader; a guide.
example: ಅವನು ನಮ್ಮ ಗುಂಪಿನ ಅಗ್ರೇಸರನಾಗಿ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಮುನ್ನಡೆಸಿದನು.
example_en: He led everyone as the leader of our group.

definition: a small brook.
example_en: A small brook was flowing behind the house.

definition: the act of eating food.
example_en: Eating is a necessary act for every living being.

definition: a man having passion, desire, etc.; a passionate man.
example: ಆ ವೀತರಾಗದ್ವೇಷಿಯು ತನ್ನ ಆಸೆಗಳನ್ನು ತಡೆಯಲಾರದೆ ಹೋದನು.
example_en: That passionate man could not restrain his desires.

definition: haughty, domineering or overbearing behaviour.
example_en: Everyone was fed up with his haughty, overbearing behaviour.

definition: the outer rim of a wheel; felly.
example_en: The wheel's felly of the cart broke.

definition: the body of human being that is not clothed; a bare body.
example_en: He stood in the sun with his body bare.

definition: the state of being completely wet or soaked.
example_en: Drenched in the rain, his clothes became completely soaked.

definition: a solution of ammonia and ammonium salt got in gas making; a gas liquor.
example_en: Gas liquor was being released from the factory.

definition: a heavy, thick, short metal bar used by a smith working in bronze or brass.
example_en: The smith struck the bronze vessel with the heavy metal bar.

definition: to be before or first.
example_en: He began the work before everyone else.

definition: a means of earning one's living; occupation, work or line of business; trade.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಚಿಕ್ಕಂದಿನಿಂದಲೂ ಕಸಬುಗಾರಿಕೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಸಕ್ತಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: He had interest in a trade or occupation since childhood.

definition: (growth of someone or something) to be checked; to have stunted growth.
example_en: Due to the heat of the sun, the sapling's growth was stunted.

definition: how much.
example: ಈ ಚೀಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಂತುಟು ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಇದೆ ಎಂದು ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: It is not known how much rice is in this sack.

definition: that which is in a liquid or watery condition.
example_en: They carefully strained the watery liquid in the bowl.

definition: a man who is under another's arbitrary control.
example_en: He lived as a man under his master's control.

definition: to ask a question or questions; to question.
example_en: The teacher encouraged the students to ask questions.

definition: the statue or model of a woman or girl (standing in an aeasthetic posture).
example: ಉದ್ಯಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸುಂದರ ಶಿಲಾಬಾಲಿಕೆಯ ಪ್ರತಿಮೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a beautiful stone maiden statue in the garden.

definition: a particular kind of clothing.
example_en: She wore the old paniyavasa garment for the festival.

definition: a system of protection against loss in which a number of individuals agree to pay certain sums; insurance.
example_en: He got insurance for the house.

definition: a knowledgeable, scholarly man; a scholar.
example: ಆ ವೇತ್ತ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಳವಾದ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That scholar had deep knowledge of the scriptures.

definition: to overcome the state of holding differing opinion or disagreement, uncertainty etc.
example: ಚರ್ಚೆಯ ನಂತರ ಅವರಿಬ್ಬರೂ ಎರವಳಿಯನ್ನು ಮೀರಿ ಒಪ್ಪಿಕೊಂಡರು.
example_en: After the discussion, both of them overcame their disagreement and agreed.

definition: the office or status of the revenue officer, asaph.
example_en: He obtained the office of the revenue officer in that town.

definition: much higher in some quality or degree; much above the ordinary or average; existing in a high degree; intense.
example_en: His speech was outstanding.

definition: a variety of guava which bear fruits of reddish flesh.
example_en: The inside of the reddish-fleshed guava fruit is red.

definition: the pane of a door.
example_en: The door's pane broke and fell.

definition: walked over; stepped on; trodden, hence made shapeless.
example_en: The flower was trodden under people's feet and became shapeless.

definition: want of digestion.
example_en: Because of overeating, he suffered from indigestion.

definition: a cloud.
example_en: A cloud covered the sky and rain came.

definition: a small village or town.
example_en: There are only a few houses in that small village.

definition: expressed; manifested; that has become apparent or obvious.
example_en: Joy was expressed on his face.

definition: old, torn clothes; rags.
example_en: The poor man was wearing old, torn clothes.

definition: a commissioned military officer ranking next below a lieutenant colonel and next above a captain; a major.
example_en: That major gave orders to the soldiers.

definition: to treat contemptuously; to belittle; to slight.
example_en: The elder sister spoke belittling the younger sister.

definition: buying and selling; trade.
example_en: Buying and selling went on briskly in the market.

definition: to be collected in large number, quanity or to a great degree.
example_en: People were collected in large numbers at the fair.

definition: Rāmāyaṇa, by Vālmīki, acknowledged as the first poem in Samskřta language.
example_en: The Adikavya was composed by Valmiki.

definition: the knowledge or feeling of duality (between the Supreme Being and the individual soul).
example_en: The feeling of duality about the soul arises from ignorance.

definition: to cause to move; to move or displace; to push.
example_en: The wind moved the tree branch.

definition: a metric unit of weight, equal to 100 kilograms (220.46 lbs.); a quintal.
example: ರೈತ ಒಂದು ಕ್ವಿಂಟಲ್ ಭತ್ತವನ್ನು ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಗೆ ತಂದನು.
example_en: The farmer brought one quintal of paddy to the market.

definition: to look forward, expect the arrival of.
example: ಅವಳು ಗಂಟೆಗಟ್ಟಲೆ ಅವನ ಆಗಮನವನ್ನು ಪರಿಪಾರ್ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: She waited and expected his arrival for hours.

definition: the creeper Cucumis melo ( = C. aromaticus, = C. utilissimus) of Cucurbitaceae family.
example_en: The fruits of the Cucumis melo creeper are sweet.

definition: any substance that destroys life or impairs health when consumed, absorbed or injected into the body; a poison.
example_en: That snake's poison was very potent.

definition: the expanse or area between two things.
example: ಎರಡು ಮನೆಗಳ ಎಡೆದಱಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ತೋಟವಿತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a small garden in the expanse between the two houses.

definition: to carry a burden on the shoulder or on the back of the neck in the slings on both sides of a lath.
example_en: He carried the heavy bundle on his shoulder with slings on both sides of a lath and moved on.

definition: the large, deciduous tree Melia composita of Meliaceae family; great neem; giant neem.
example: ಅಂಗಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆದ ಹೆಬ್ಬೇವು ಬಿಸಿಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ನೆರಳು ಕೊಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: The great neem tree that grew in the courtyard gave a large shade in the sun.

definition: the cutting edge of a sword.
example_en: The cutting edge of the warrior's sword tore through the enemies.

definition: the sound made while spitting saliva.
example_en: Do not spit on the road with that spitting sound.

definition: the cardinal number two hundred; 200.
example_en: There are two hundred houses in that village.

definition: a kind of variation of sound by pulling a string of a musical instrument, in a measured manner.
example_en: The musician pulled the string and made the quavering variation of sound.

definition: a merchant who sells goods usu. to other dealers, merchants, in relatively large quantities; a wholesaler.
example_en: The wholesaler sold sugar in sacks to the shops.

definition: the condition or an instance of one's heart throbbing abnormally (from fear, anxiety, etc.).
example: ಅಪಘಾತದ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಎದೆಹಾಱುತನ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing the news of the accident, her heart began throbbing abnormally with fear.

definition: the tip of the tongue.
example_en: The hot tea burned the tip of the tongue.

definition: a dwelling place; a house.
example_en: That poor family has no dwelling place.

definition: that which comes in.
example_en: These goods came as imports from abroad.

definition: a children's play.
example_en: The children were playing the gambadagadane game in the yard.

definition: the unlawful premeditated killing of a human being by another; a murder or murdering.
example: ಆ ಖೂನಿನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಪೊಲೀಸರು ತನಿಖೆ ನಡೆಸಿದರು.
example_en: The police conducted an investigation into that murder.

definition: of different kinds or varieties.
example_en: Various kinds of clothes are available in the shop.

definition: different; not the same; another.
example_en: These two cloths are different in colour.

definition: frequent pantings or gaspings.
example_en: The old man suffered frequent gasping while climbing the stairs.

definition: the state of being agitated; perturbed condition.
example: ಆ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸು ವಿಚಲಿತವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing that news, his mind fell into a perturbed condition.

definition: a kind of fire-cracker, that goes up like a rocket, when lit; a sky-rocket.
example_en: On the festival day they set off sky-rockets in the sky.

definition: to free (grain) from the lighter particles of chaff, dirt, etc., esp. by throwing it into the air and allowing the wind or a forced current of air to blow away impurities; to winnow.
example_en: The farmer winnowed the paddy in the wind.

definition: an idle or empty talk.
example_en: All his talk is idle chatter, do not believe it.

definition: (the horn) to be put forth.
example_en: The horn was put forth on the head of the young deer.

definition: a man belonging to the earliest period of the history of mankind (i.e. of pre-historic period).
example_en: Primitive man lived in caves.

definition: bursting forth from below the earth; sprouting.
example_en: In the rainy season, sprouting plants are seen everywhere.

definition: a foot-operated lever used in transmitting motion, on a bicycle; a pedal.
example_en: The bicycle's pedal had broken.

definition: the quality or fact of being straight; straightness.
example_en: The straightness of that stick was pleasing to see.

definition: a weapon consisting of a metal tube from which a projectile is discharged by the force of an explosive; a rifle; a gun.
example_en: The hunter aimed the rifle at the deer.

definition: the tree Santalum album ( = Sirium myrtifolium) of Santalaceae family, known for its sweet smelling heartwood; sandalwood.
example: ಅರಣ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆದ ಸಿರಿಕಂಡ ಮರದಿಂದ ಸುಗಂಧ ಬರುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A sweet fragrance came from the sandalwood tree growing in the forest.

definition: the feather of an arrow.
example_en: The feather of the arrow flapped in the wind.

definition: thin; slim; slender.
example_en: That boy has a slim body.

definition: one's natural quality (not acquired).
example_en: Honesty was his natural quality.

definition: a man who deserves to be cursed.
example: ಆ ವಂಚಕ ಶಾಪಾರುಹ ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone said that the cheat was a man deserving to be cursed.

definition: to thread or bead on a string; to make a garland (of flowers) or a string.
example_en: She threaded the flowers into a garland and offered them to the god.

definition: the cardinal number five; 5.
example_en: There were coins numbering five in that bag.

definition: a kind of plant.
example_en: They planted the bellagoṭṭe plant near the fence.

definition: a kind of percussion instrument.
example_en: The sound of the avuja instrument resounded at the festival.

definition: to be likened with another; to be compared with another to show resemblances and differences.
example_en: His conduct is compared with his father's conduct.

definition: a psychoneurosis marked by emotional excitability and disturbances of psychic, sensory, vasomotor and visceral functions; hysteria.
example_en: She developed hysteria from the shock.

definition: for several years.
example: ಆ ಕುಟುಂಬ ವರ್ಷಗಟ್ಟಳೆ ಈ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That family lived in this house for several years.

definition: swiftly; quickly.
example_en: He finished the work quickly.

definition: a small, long-tailed minivet of the genus Pericrocotus, having in the male black and red and in the female black and orange plumage; a red minivet.
example: ಚಿಟಗ ಮರದ ಕೊಂಬೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಚಿಲಿಪಿಲಿ ಎಂದಿತು.
example_en: The red minivet sat on the tree branch and chirped.

definition: to turn away one's attention (from something).
example_en: Hearing the noise, she turned her attention away from the book.

definition: a huge bungalow.
example_en: Hundreds of people lived in that huge bungalow.

definition: to resound with an echo; to reproduce a sound that is coming from opposite; to echo.
example: ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಕಣಿವೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ಕೂಗು ಎದುರ್ದನಿಯಾಗಿ ಮರಳಿ ಬಂತು.
example_en: In the mountain valley, his shout came back as an echo.

definition: a hairy tail.
example_en: The dog had a thick hairy tail.

definition: to cause to order to blow a trumpet.
example_en: The commander had the trumpet blown and began the war.

definition: a small cot.
example_en: The child was sleeping peacefully on the small cot.

definition: to know by some detail, as of appearance; to identify; to recognise.
example_en: It became easy to identify him in the crowd.

definition: wicked, intentionally harmful.
example_en: Everyone kept away from that wicked man.

definition: a Muslim placethat usu. has a minaret; a mosque.
example_en: The prayer took place in the village mosque.

definition: (agitation, disturbance) to spread widely and violently.
example_en: Chaos spread violently in the crowd.

definition: the abode of gods.
example_en: According to the puranas, heaven itself is the abode of the gods.

definition: a poet lacking natural sympathy, pity, compassion etc.
example: ಆ ಕಲ್ಲೆರ್ದೆಗವಿ ದುಃಖಿತರ ಗೀತೆಯನ್ನೂ ಗೇಲಿ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That heartless poet even mocked the songs of the sorrowful.

definition: the flow of water (as in stream).
example_en: The flow of water was moving slowly.

definition: that is to be kept, placed, deposited.
example: ಈ ಒಡವೆಗಳು ಸ್ಥಾಪ್ಯವಾದ ವಸ್ತುಗಳಾಗಿವೆ, ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಇಡಬೇಕು.
example_en: These jewels are items to be deposited; they must be kept in the bank.

definition: a man who is a good striker, shooter or archer.
example_en: The skilled archer hit the target with his bow.

definition: to discharge or fire a bullet at or on; to shoot.
example_en: The policeman fired a bullet at the thief.

definition: a man in the last moments of his life; a dying man.
example_en: That dying man spoke his last words.

definition: the unwavering, resolute mind.
example_en: His unwavering and resolute mind faced every defeat.

definition: that which is very common or which is not in anyway special.
example_en: This is a common matter, nothing special.

definition: the royal highway in a city.
example_en: The king's procession went through the royal highway.

definition: a man who practices piracy; esp., a robber of ships on the high seas; a pirate.
example_en: That pirate had plundered several ships.

definition: lack of reasoning, thinking power; stupidity.
example_en: Everyone was deceived because of his stupidity.

definition: a separating oneself from others and standing apart.
example: ಅವನು ಜನರಿಂದ ಅಲಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಒಂದು ಮೂಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಂತನು.
example_en: He stood apart from the people in a corner.

definition: the small tree Phylllanthus maderaspatensis of Euphorbiaceae family.
example_en: A bhū nelli tree grew on the field bund.

definition: any worm-blooded vertebrate of the class Mammalia, having the body more or less covered with hair, nourishing the young with milk secreted from the mammary glands; a mammal.
example_en: The elephant is a large mammal.

definition: shyless; immodest; shameless.
example: ನಾಣಿಲಿ ಮಾತುಗಳನ್ನು ಆಡಬೇಡ ಎಂದು ಅಪ್ಪ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: Father warned him not to speak shameless words.

definition: to flow to a long distance or for long time.
example_en: The river flowed to a long distance across the plain.

definition: that which is worn out or abraded by constant use.
example_en: Wear from daily use is visible on the cloth.

definition: to cause to fall down or tumble; to fell.
example_en: The strong wind felled the tree.

definition: a bamboo split lengthwise.
example_en: He wove a basket from a lengthwise bamboo split.

definition: plentiful; abundant; profuse; bountiful.
example_en: That year there was a plentiful store of grain.

definition: immeiately; suddenly.
example_en: Suddenly the light went out.

definition: that which is within reasonable limits; moderateness.
example: ಆಹಾರ ಸೇವನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಳತ ಕಾಪಾಡುವುದು ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದು.
example_en: Maintaining moderation in eating is good for health.

definition: to express mirth, pleasure, derision or nervousness with an audible, vocal expulsion of air from the lungs that can range from a loud burst of sound to a series of quiet chuckles and is usu. accompanied by characteristic facial and bodily movements; to laugh.
example: ಅವನ ತಮಾಷೆಯ ಮಾತು ಕೇಳಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಜೋರಾಗಿ ನಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: Hearing his funny words, the children were laughing loudly.

definition: a band of cloth or grass tied round the waist.
example_en: He tied a cloth band around his waist.

definition: not soiled; perfectly clean.
example_en: She wore a spotlessly clean white saree.

definition: a female human being; a woman.
example_en: A woman was standing near the door.

definition: the plant Schefflera racemosa ( = Heptapleurum racemosa) of Araliaceae family.
example_en: A Schefflera racemosa tree had grown at the edge of the forest.

definition: the chief of a town or village.
example_en: The village chief called a meeting of the townspeople.

definition: any of an order (Psittaciformes) of tropical or subtropical birds with a hooked bill, brightly coloured feathers, and feet having two toes pointing forward and two backward, some of which can learn to imitate human speech; a parrot.
example_en: They were selling a parrot in the shop.

definition: a light sleep; doze; nap.
example_en: After the meal, a light sleep came over her.

definition: to clarify or explain with an intention to convince.
example_en: The teacher clarified the matter to the disciple to convince him.

definition: a right, advantage, favour or immunity specially granted to one; a privilege.
example_en: Employees have a travel privilege.

definition: a kind high-pitched war-trumpet.
example_en: The sound of the war-trumpet on the battlefield roused the soldiers.

definition: the sun setting in the evening.
example_en: The village looked beautiful in the light of the setting sun.

definition: the human body.
example_en: Through yoga, the body stays healthy.

definition: dirt; filth; unlcean matter.
example_en: Dirt had formed on the cloth.

definition: an arrow with a crescent-head.
example_en: He raised the crescent-headed arrow and took aim.

definition: a small hand-held toy, that makes a low rattling sound when spun.
example_en: The child is spinning the rattle toy and playing.

definition: the supposed disembodied spirit of a dead person; a ghost; a spectre.
example: ಆ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪೇತ ಇದೆ ಎಂಬ ನಂಬಿಕೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a belief that a ghost exists in that forest.

definition: one whose profession is measuring the extent, dimension, capacity, etc.; a measurer.
example: ಆವಟಿಗನು ಜಮೀನಿನ ಉದ್ದ ಮತ್ತು ಅಗಲವನ್ನು ಅಳೆದನು.
example_en: The measurer measured the length and breadth of the field.

definition: (dial.) the floor below another in a multi-storeyed building; a downstairs.
example_en: There is a shop on the downstairs floor of that building.

definition: a man who has undergone penance and an austere way of life.
example_en: That man who had undergone penance lived alone in the forest.

definition: the earth's surface.
example_en: The sun's heat warmed the earth's surface.

definition: the cardinal number nineteen; 19.
example_en: He is now nineteen years old.

definition: to go back to original or previous position or place; to retreat.
example_en: The wounded animal retreated and ran into the forest.

definition: a group of people related by ancestry or marriage; relatives.
example_en: All our relatives had come for the festival.

definition: trembling; quivering; palpitating; tremulous.
example_en: His hand trembled with fear.

definition: a small bar with tapered ends used for the same purpose in hand-spinning; a spindle.
example_en: The weaver was spinning thread, holding the spindle in his hand.

definition: to make, take a vow, promise by a vow, as to a god or saint; to vow.
example_en: The devotees made a vow at the temple and sought blessings.

definition: rapidity in moving, going, travelling, proceeding or performing.
example: ಕುದುರೆಯ ದುವ್ವಳಿ ನೋಡಿ ಜನರು ಚಪ್ಪಾಳೆ ತಟ್ಟಿದರು.
example_en: People clapped seeing the rapid pace of the horse.

definition: a sub-sect among holeyas, the erstwhile untouchables in Indian social class.
example_en: The Ajila sub-sect lived in that region.

definition: the earth.
example_en: Many creatures live upon the earth.

definition: a knot of hair on the scalp.
example_en: She tied a knot of hair on her scalp.

definition: any vessel of considerable size (larger than a boat), propelled by sails or powered by an engine, navigating deep water; a ship.
example_en: A big ship had anchored at the harbour.

definition: a door-peg; a bolt.
example_en: They fixed the door-bolt securely to the door.

definition: a touching or being touched; a physical contact; a touch.
example_en: The touch of the breeze felt cool on the body.

definition: conquering booty or wealth.
example_en: Arjuna is also called Dhananjaya, the conqueror of wealth.

definition: the mother of one's wife or husband; mother-in-law.
example: ಅವಳ ಶ್ವಶ್ರು ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯಿಂದ ಇರುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
example_en: Her mother-in-law is affectionate to everyone at home.

definition: a piece of cloth for making a blouse; a blouse-piece.
example_en: She bought a blouse-piece of cloth from the shop.

definition: a flash of light in the sky caused by the discharge of atmospheric electricity from one cloud to another or between a cloud and the earth; lightning.
example_en: Lightning flashed and thundered in the sky.

definition: an incomprehensible subject, matter, secret, etc.; a mysterious thing.
example_en: The subject of that book was an incomprehensible matter for ordinary people.

definition: (beauty) to be spoiled.
example_en: Because of the wound, the beauty of her face was spoiled.

definition: a loud, confused noise.
example_en: The confused noise of people was heard in the market.

definition: Manmatha, the Love-God.
example_en: In the puranas, Singa is called the god of love.

definition: a living in a different or unusual, way.
example_en: Everyone was surprised to see his unusual way of living.

definition: the fact or condition of depending entirely on another for sustenance.
example: ಮುದುಕನ ಜೀವನ ಮಗನ ಪರಪೋಷ್ಯದ ಮೇಲೆ ಆಧಾರಿತವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The old man's life depended entirely on his son's support.

definition: a woman of red, slightly reddish or reddish brown complexion.
example: ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬ ಸುಂದರ ಕೆಂಚಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: A beautiful reddish-complexioned woman lived in that village.

definition: (a ligament or muscle of a joint) to be wrenched (without the bones being dislocated).
example_en: While running, the muscle of his leg was wrenched.

definition: a gloomy face expressing one's wretched condition.
example: ಆಕೆಯ ದೈನ್ಯವದನ ನೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಕರುಣೆ ಬಂತು.
example_en: Seeing her wretched, gloomy face, everyone felt pity.

definition: (mus.) a time-cycle, having one laghu, one dřta followed by another laghu (laghu being of varied length).

definition: a large, rectangular piece of cotton, linen, silk, etc., used on a bed or as a wrapper over the body; a sheet; bedspread.
example_en: They fitted a colourful sheet to the cot.

definition: a kind of small plant akin to spinach of of Basellaceae family.
example_en: They use hebbasale greens in cooking.

definition: crop raised in the field; green crop.
example_en: A green crop was thriving all over the field.

definition: an abominable, detestable man.
example_en: That detestable man helps no one.

definition: the red metal; copper.
example_en: Vessels are made from copper.

definition: to attempt, do (something) hastily; to be unduly hasty.
example_en: In a hurry, he did the work too hastily.

definition: curly hair, (esp. dangling on the forehead); lock.

example_en: A beautiful curly lock was dangling on her forehead.

definition: the spiny shrub, Ajima tetracantha.
example_en: A spiny shrub has grown near the fence.

definition: the tree Avicennia officinalis ( = A. tomentosa) of Verbenaceae family; common white mangrove.
example_en: People use the common white mangrove tree for medicine.

definition: the profession of buying and selling of comodities; commerce.
example_en: Commerce thrives well in this town.

definition: a temporary platform, scaffold, etc. made using wooden planks.

example_en: The carpenters built a plank platform in front of the house and placed the goods on it.

definition: something that seems to appear to the sight but has no physical existence; a spectre.
example: ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಗುರ್ಮ ಕಂಡು ಅವನು ಭಯದಿಂದ ಓಡಿದನು.
example_en: Seeing a spectre in the forest, he ran away in fear.

definition: the fact of being spread over a wide area.

example_en: The spread of rainwater was there across the whole plain.

definition: to create fear, alarm in another's mind.
example_en: That sound created fear in the children's minds.

definition: to wander or roam about.
example_en: That traveler was wandering about in the new town.

definition: a music or dance programme performed with a fairly large audience.
example_en: A music programme with a large audience took place in the palace in the evening.

definition: a flight of parrots.
example_en: A flight of parrots was flying in the sky.

definition: a thing kept or meant to be kept secret or known only to a few; a secret.
example_en: He did not tell his secret to anyone.

definition: a colour that is added; an artificial colour.

definition: a very severe curse or swear-word.

definition: (pl.) irrigated and rain-fed fields.

definition: to be left untilled, unploughed; to become fallow.
example_en: That paddy field has remained fallow for years.

definition: the way, manner in which something is done or to be done.
example_en: This work must be done in the proper manner.

definition: an organised net-work created deliberately to cheat people.
example_en: People lost money in that organised cheating network.

definition: a oozing of water in drops (as from an underground source).
example_en: Water was oozing in drops from the crack in the rock.

definition: flames of fire.
example_en: The flames of fire rose up into the sky.

definition: great warmth; heat; hotness.
example_en: Everyone grew weary from the heat of summer.

definition: bursting into pieces; in a shattered or strewn condition.

definition: to bow, sag from weight above.

definition: a payment, not wages, made regularly to a person (or to his family) who has fulfilled certain conditions of service, reached a certain age, etc.; pension.

definition: the act of keeping things tidily and in orderly fashion.

definition: the state of being proficient; skill; expertness; proficiency.

definition: being under another's control; ruled, controlled by another or others.

definition: heavily wounded or injured.

definition: bliss or delightment that one derives from within.
example_en: One who has experienced inner bliss does not need external pleasure.

definition: to come out; to send out; to ooze out.
example_en: Sweat oozed out in the sun.

definition: the natural outer covering of fruits or vegetables; the skin.
example_en: I peeled off the banana's skin and threw it away.

definition: a kind of large bushy plant of Rubiaceae family, akin to honey-thorn.
example_en: In the forest, the large bushy plant had grown big.

definition: to direct (one's efforts); to try to achieve; to aim.
example_en: He aimed to achieve higher education.

definition: the superintendent of a horse-stable.

example_en: That superintendent of the horse-stable looked after all the stable's work.

definition: the act or an instance of paying out money, esp. wages; disbursement.
example_en: The company disburses wages at the end of the month.

definition: to pull with force (repeatedly, as in quarrelling).
example_en: The two quarrelled and pulled at each other with force.

definition: one who knows all about the soul and the Supreme or the divine knowledge; one well versed in the Vedanta philosophy.
example_en: The knower of the soul taught divine knowledge to everyone.

definition: abstention from stealing.
example_en: Everyone admired his quality of abstaining from stealing.

definition: to cause to incite, provoke (someone).

example_en: He repeatedly provoked me and dragged me into a fight.

definition: the part of a shore closest to the water; fore-shore.

definition: an unfortunate, unlucky person.

definition: per hundred; in proportion to one hundred.
example: ಈ ಬಾರಿ ಶೇಕಡಾ ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತರಷ್ಟು ಬೆಲೆ ಏರಿಕೆಯಾಯಿತು.

definition: to string flowers to make a garland.
example_en: The daughter strung flowers into a garland for worship.

definition: to jump over; to step over.
example_en: The boy jumped over the ditch.

definition: to remove; to eliminate; to get rid of.
example_en: The garbage must be removed from the house.

definition: the act of bringing near.

definition: to attack in retaliation and take hold of.

definition: a wound or abscess; a sore; an ulcer.

definition: a toothless person.
example_en: The toothless old woman spoke while laughing.

definition: a small conch.

definition: to grow (oneself) well.

example_en: With proper nourishment, the plant grows well.

definition: to be stabbed.
example_en: He was stabbed by the thieves with a knife.

definition: a frame, as of a press, operated mechanically or hydraulically, to press or apply pressure on or compress an object.

example_en: In the factory, the press frame compresses and shapes the metal.

definition: the science of statistical analysis of economic data and their inter-relations and economic theories; econometrics.
example_en: Students study econometrics at the university.

definition: regard with contempt or a feeling of superiority; to look down upon.
example_en: The rich man looked down upon that poor man with contempt.

definition: a job done in a circumambulatory, complicated manner.

example_en: His is always a roundabout, complicated way of doing work; he never does it directly.

definition: to go in between; to interfere.
example: ಇತರರ ವಿಷಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನಡುವಾಯಬೇಡ ಎಂದು ಹಿರಿಯರು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: Elders said not to interfere in others' matters.

definition: pained; afflicted; distressed.
example: ಅವಳ ದೂನ ಮುಖ ನೋಡಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ದುಃಖವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Seeing her distressed face, he felt sad.

definition: insulted; humiliated; treated with disrespect or discourtesy.
example_en: He was insulted in front of everyone in the meeting.

definition: a man who travels to a shrine or holy place as a religious act; a pilgrim.
example_en: That pilgrim had travelled to many holy places.

definition: amatory sport helping or exciting sexual stimulation preceding intercourse.
example_en: The couple engaged in amatory play and enjoyed themselves.

definition: the surrounding or adjoining area; neighbourhood.
example_en: One should keep the surroundings of the house clean.

definition: act of producing fire by friction (esp. by rubbing two pieces of Ficus religiosa or Acacia ferruginea wood).
example_en: Ancient people used to produce fire by friction.

definition: beauty of the nature.
example_en: The natural beauty of this mountain is wonderful.

definition: a cloak used to cover the head and the back of a child.
example_en: The mother covered the child with a cloak.

definition: the western part; the land, ocean, etc. lying on the western side.
example_en: The sun is setting in the western part of the sky.

definition: a turning around; a rolling onward; a moving about.
example_en: The turning of the wheel happened slowly.

definition: darkness within.

definition: the entire physical structure of a living being; the body.
example_en: His body was weak.

definition: the act of jumping, rebounding; a bouncing back.
example_en: The children are delighted to watch the ball's bounce.

definition: the quality, state or an instance of being one in spirit, sentiment, purpose, action, etc.; unanimity; unity; harmony; agreement.
example_en: We won through unity.

definition: the state of the bodily strength and vigour being on decline; old age.
example_en: In old age his body grew weary.

definition: a man studying the Vedic hymns.
example_en: The Vedic scholar studies the Vedas.

definition: the contractile circular opening, apparently black, in the center of the iris of the eye; the pupil of the eye.
example_en: In the bright light, the pupil of his eye became small.

definition: the aesthitic taste.
example_en: Her aesthetic taste is clearly seen in her painting.

definition: a man whose work is carrying and delivering mail; a letter carrier; a postman.
example_en: The postal courier delivers mail from house to house.

definition: the condition of being overwhelmed with the feeling of fear.
example: ಆ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಬೆಚ್ಚು ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: He was overwhelmed with fear on hearing that news.

definition: the position, rank, dignity of a king; kingship.
example_en: His kingship continued for twenty years.

definition: of a violently cruel nature; fierce; ferocious.
example: ಆ ಹುಲಿಯ ರವರವ ಸ್ವಭಾವ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಭಯ ಹುಟ್ಟಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That tiger's fierce nature instilled fear in everyone.

definition: to be in a horizontal, recumbent or prostrate position, as on a bed or the ground; to recline; to lie.
example_en: He was tired and lay down on the bed.

definition: (pros.) a metrical verse having four groups of three syllables each (u-u, -uu, uu-, u-u) followed by a long syllable (-), having thirteen syllables in total.
example: ಆ ಕವಿ ರುಚಿರ ಛಂದಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪದ್ಯವನ್ನು ರಚಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That poet composed the verse in the rucira metre.

definition: a shaving of the head or the head being shaven.
example_en: Before initiation, they had his head shaven.

definition: a handing over the possession of (a person as a prisoner).
example_en: The police handed over the prisoner to the court in a prisoner transfer.

definition: to suck in; to absorb.
example_en: The sponge quickly absorbed the water.

definition: to hide (something) in the ground.
example_en: The thief hid the gold in the ground.

definition: a quack - a) an untrained person who practices medicine fraudulently; b) any person who pretends to have knowledge or skill that he or she does not have in a particular field; charlatan.
example_en: Do not take medicine from a quack.

definition: a kind of cracker that burns with sparklings and soft cracking sound.
example_en: The child danced happily holding the sparkling cracker.

definition: lasting for a short period only; not permanent; temporary.
example_en: He got only a temporary job.
